title: CDAD neutral context-measurement record (005-002)
description: Runtime-agnostic measurement record emitted by the canonical adapter (skills/cdad-cycle/scripts/cdad_context_meter.py). The record is the CONTRACT; the adapter only translates, and it is the only layer that knows the source table/column names. The record therefore carries NO runtime names (neutrality). Every metric lives in EXACTLY ONE explicit bucket (observed/estimated/unknown). A null/absent/not-reported value is unknown WITH a cause, never 0. No bytes-to-tokens conversion and no fabricated context/limit.

schema_version.description: Version of the NEUTRAL record (distinct from the source, which has no schema marker).

run.description: The run: a hashed/omitted reference to the store, the observed runtime version and whether the source schema was recognized.

store_ref.description: Hashed/omitted reference to the store (privacy): never an absolute path.

runtime_version.description: Runtime version observed in the source.

schema.description: Whether the source schema was recognized. An unrecognized schema fails closed before any record is emitted.

reader.description: OPTIONAL: declares the reader's recognized dispatch tools, so the consumer knows the limit of the dispatch detection (D4). A dispatch made with a tool outside `dispatch_tools` is NOT detected by this reader.

application.description: OPTIONAL referenced application annotation (PD-9). It is a reference, NOT a copy of content, and the reader never approves anything.

unknowns.description: Explicit causes of what is not observable. An entry names its cause in text.

window.description: The window and cut actually used, explicit and reproducible.

reader.description: The reader's declared recognition surface (D4). `dispatch_tools` is the set of tools this reader recognizes as a role work dispatch; a dispatch made with any other tool is NOT detected, so an absence caused by an unrecognized tool is distinguishable from a dispatch that did not happen.

dispatch_tools.description: Tools recognized as a role work dispatch (e.g. subagent, task).

position.description: Position of a milestone in the trace of the tramo: call/message index and its seq.

milestone.description: One milestone of a session/tramo. `position` and `time_relative` are required when observed; `cause` is required when absent/unknown.

time_relative.description: Time relative to the start of the tramo, in minutes. When the milestone POSITION is observable but its time is NOT, this is null (never a fabricated 0) and the milestone carries a cause declaring the time not observable (D1).

cause.description: Observable cause of the absence (required when absent/unknown).

milestones.description: Two separate milestones, both present as keys even when absent/unknown.

measure.description: One metric: `unit` and `provenance` are mandatory, `value` may be null (which makes it unknown with a cause). The `input_per_step` measure additionally carries the `truncated` indicator declaring the output-size policy (PD-12/D2).

value.description: The measured value, or null when it cannot be observed (then the bucket is unknown). For `input_per_step` this is EITHER the fixed-size default summary (`#/$defs/input_per_step_summary`, emitted unless the caller passes the detail flag) OR the full ordered per-step array (one element per step; a null element means the proxy is not observable for that step, never 0).

unit.description: Mandatory unit (minutes, calls, unicode characters, tokens, ...).

input_per_step_summary.description: FIXED-SIZE default summary of the per-step context proxy (PD-12/D2). Its shape does not grow with the number of steps, so one session's document stays at or below the published limit of 16384 bytes whatever the session size. A proxy that is not observable is `null` (in last/previous/min/max), NEVER 0, and counted in `unobserved`. The full ordered per-step detail is emitted only when the caller passes the detail flag declared in the measure's `truncated.detail_flag`.

count.description: Number of steps of the stretch.

last.description: Proxy of the LAST step of the stretch, or null when it is not observable (never 0).

previous.description: Proxy of the step before the last, or null when there is none or it is not observable (never 0).

min.description: Smallest OBSERVABLE proxy of the stretch, or null when there is no observable proxy (never 0).

max.description: Largest OBSERVABLE proxy of the stretch, or null when there is no observable proxy (never 0).

unobserved.description: How many steps of the stretch have no observable proxy.

truncated.description: Indicator of the output-size policy and its cause (PD-12/D2), declared on the `input_per_step` measure so the omission of the per-step detail is never silent. By default the detail is omitted to honor the published limit of 16384 bytes per single-session document (truncated=true, omitted_steps=count); with the detail flag it is emitted in full and the limit does not apply (truncated=false, omitted_steps=0).
Whether the per-step detail was omitted from the document.

cause.description: Text declaring WHY the detail is omitted (or that it was emitted in full), citing the published limit and the detail flag.

omitted_steps.description: How many steps are not detailed (equal to count by default; 0 with the detail flag).

detail_flag.description: Name of the flag that restores the full per-step detail.

measures.description: Mandatory orientation measures. Each is a `measure` (value/unit/provenance/bucket); `cache` nests its read/write components. A measure that cannot be observed is unknown with a cause, never 0.

cache.description: Cache tokens: read observed; write unknown when the provider does not report it (never 0).

bucket_members.description: Names of the metrics assigned to one bucket.

buckets.description: Explicit buckets and the ASSIGNMENT RULE (mandatory): every metric lives in EXACTLY ONE bucket, never in two. observed = read directly from the record (reported tokens, reported cost, call counts, positions, times, output size). estimated = declared proxy (context loaded per step = input + cache.read + cache.write; NOT the real window). unknown = null/absent/not-reported WITH a cause, NEVER 0.

parent_ref.description: Hashed parent session reference, or null.

role.description: Aggregate per role. Each SUMMED component declares its COVERAGE (R1): a partial subtotal is never presented as the role total. `sums.sessions` is the INTEGER member count; every other `sums` entry is a declared aggregate entry. Each `distributions` entry declares the coverage of its values.

sums.description: Sums over the role's sessions. `sessions` is the INTEGER member count (a count of members, never a sum of a measure). EVERY other entry is a DECLARED aggregate entry `{value, unit, bucket, sessions_reporting, sessions_total, cause}`: the sum is `observed` with a numeric `value` only when EVERY session of the role reports the component (`sessions_reporting == sessions_total`, `cause` null); otherwise it is `unknown` with `value` null and a `cause` declaring the coverage — a partial subtotal is NEVER presented as the role total. A plain number for a summed component does not validate.

distributions.description: Distributions over the role's sessions. EVERY entry is a DECLARED distribution `{values, sessions_reporting, sessions_total, cause}` declaring its coverage: the observed `values` are a subset of the sessions, never presented as the whole role. A plain array does not validate.

role_aggregate_entry.description: One SUMMED component of `roles[].sums`, with its declared COVERAGE (R1). `sessions_reporting` and `sessions_total` are ALWAYS numbers, never null. When `sessions_reporting == sessions_total` the sum is a COMPLETE observation: bucket `observed`, numeric `value`, `cause` null. Otherwise the entry is `unknown` with `value` null — a partial subtotal is NEVER emitted as the role total — and `cause` declares the coverage (k of n).

value.description: The complete sum, or null when the coverage is incomplete (never a partial subtotal).

sessions_reporting.description: How many sessions of the role report the component (always a number).

sessions_total.description: How many sessions the role aggregates (always a number).

cause.description: Null with full coverage; the coverage cause (naming role, component and k of n) when incomplete.

role_distribution.description: One distribution of `roles[].distributions`, with its declared COVERAGE (R1): `values` carries only the OBSERVED evidence of the sessions that report it (a subset of the role's sessions is never presented as the whole role), `sessions_reporting`/`sessions_total` declare the coverage (always numbers, never null) and `cause` is null only with full coverage.

values.description: The observed values of the sessions that report the distribution (a subset when the coverage is incomplete).

sessions_reporting.description: How many sessions of the role report the distribution (always a number).

sessions_total.description: How many sessions the role aggregates (always a number).

cause.description: Null with full coverage; the coverage cause (naming role, component and k of n) when incomplete.

application.description: Referenced application annotation (PD-9). `ref` is a durable reference (path/commit/receipt), NOT a copy of the content; `limit` derives from observable facts, not the reader's judgement; `basis` names those facts. The reader never approves anything.

ref.description: Durable reference (path/commit/receipt) to the application evidence; never an embedded copy.

basis.description: Observable facts that support the limit.
